analysis_status: designed after binary turnover was shown to be materially effort-sensitive; latent-state diagnostic only
purpose: Test whether repeated 5-min focal-plant censuses contain enough information to distinguish true focal interaction state from non-detection across adjacent subseasons before any detection-corrected rewiring claim is attempted.
candidate_surface: same focal-response-excluded candidate dyads used by the census-rate analysis: focal plant censused in both periods and focal pollinator independently detected on another plant in both periods

model.type: two-season dynamic occupancy/detection likelihood fitted separately to each transition

latent_states.z_previous: true focal interaction state in previous subseason
latent_states.z_current: true focal interaction state in current subseason

parameters.p_previous: per-5-min-census detection probability conditional on z_previous=1
parameters.p_current: per-5-min-census detection probability conditional on z_current=1

model.observation_model: current/previous positive focal-pollinator census counts out of identifiable focal-plant census counts
model.likelihood: sum over the four latent state pairs; z=0 permits only zero detections
model.optimizer: R optim L-BFGS-B on logit parameters with deterministic multi-starts

identifiability_gate.transition_label: IDENTIFIED only if all criteria pass; otherwise WEAK_OR_NONIDENTIFIED

posterior_diagnostics: mean posterior true-gain probability among observed binary gains
mean posterior true-loss probability among observed binary losses
promotion_rule: Do not fit or interpret an opportunity effect on latent gain/loss unless at least five of six primary transitions pass the frozen IDENTIFIED gate. If fewer than five pass, the correct result is that latent rewiring is not identified well enough from these repeated-census data.

interpretation.allowed: assess whether true link state and transition probabilities are statistically identifiable under a simple repeated-detection model
forbidden: claiming the simple occupancy model is the true ecological process
calling posterior expected transitions observed facts

claim_ceiling: This is an identifiability diagnostic. Passing would permit a detection-model sensitivity analysis; failure means the raw data do not support a defensible detection-corrected rewiring response under this simple model.
